title: Plan Upgrade and Downgrade Policy
content:
# Plan Upgrade and Downgrade Policy

## Upgrades

### How to Upgrade
1. Go to **Settings > Billing > Subscription**.
2. Click **Change Plan**.
3. Select the desired plan.
4. Review the prorated charges.
5. Confirm the upgrade.

### Upgrade Billing
- Upgrades take effect **immediately**.
- You will be charged a **prorated amount** for the remainder of the current billing cycle.
- The new plan rate applies from the next billing cycle.
- All features of the new plan are available immediately after upgrade.

### Upgrade from Pro to Enterprise
- Enterprise upgrades may require a brief onboarding call to configure SSO, RBAC, and dedicated support.
- Contact your account manager or support to initiate an Enterprise upgrade.

## Downgrades

### How to Downgrade
1. Go to **Settings > Billing > Subscription**.
2. Click **Change Plan**.
3. Select the lower-tier plan.
4. Review what features will be lost.
5. Confirm the downgrade.

### Downgrade Billing
- Downgrades take effect at the **end of the current billing cycle**.
- You retain access to all current plan features until the cycle ends.
- No prorated refunds are issued for the remaining period.
- Any usage exceeding the new plan's limits will be automatically adjusted (e.g., excess alert rules will be deactivated).

### Important Downgrade Considerations
- **Data Retention**: If downgrading from Enterprise (365 days) to Pro (30 days), historical data beyond 30 days will be archived and inaccessible (not deleted) for 90 days.
- **SSO**: Downgrading from Enterprise will disable SSO. Users will need to set passwords.
- **Integrations**: If the new plan doesn't support certain integrations, they will be paused.

## Cancellation

- You can cancel your subscription at any time from **Settings > Billing**.
- Access continues until the end of the current billing period.
- Data is retained for 30 days after cancellation, then permanently deleted.
- To reactivate, simply log in and choose a plan within the 30-day window.
